description: List the built-in technical indicators available for backtesting (RSI, moving-average crossovers, ADX, Bollinger, CCI, Stochastic, and more) with their IDs, parameters with defaults, and each indicator's default long rule. Call this to answer what strategies or indicators can be tested, or before run_backtest when unsure which indicator_id or parameters to use. Takes no arguments. Read-only and static (no market data is fetched, never rate-limited by the live budget). To find portfolios and strategies instead, use list_portfolios.
name: list_indicators
